lines.en: label day355:
scene rindemption1
: Hey, do you have a sec?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你有空吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I have plenty of secs.
lines.zh: : 有。我有一大堆 secs。

lines.en: : Heh. Secs.
lines.zh: : 呵。secs。

lines.en: scene rindemption2
: Like sex.
lines.zh: : 跟 sex 似的。

lines.en: scene rindemption3
: We can just ignore her.
lines.zh: : 我们可以直接无视她。

lines.en: I find myself talking to Otoha and Nodoka sometime in the middle of the class.
lines.zh: 不知什么时候，我发现自己正在课上跟 Otoha 和 Nodoka 聊着天。

lines.en: I tend to stop keeping track after the first hour because time is a meaningless construct and thinking about it for extended periods irritates me more than a stubborn hangnail.
lines.zh: 第一个小时之后我基本就不再计时了，因为时间是个毫无意义的概念，长时间想着它比一根顽固的倒刺还让我烦躁。

lines.en: : What do you need, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 有什么事，Otoha？

lines.en: : It’s not everyday that you of all people approach me.
lines.zh: : 你这样的人主动来找我可不常见。

lines.en: : Yeah. I try to keep my distance because there are a few girls that glare daggers at me any time I come close.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我尽量保持距离，因为有几个女生每次我一靠近就恨恨地瞪我。

lines.en: : Not that I really {i}want{/i} to anyway, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 虽然我也不是真{i}想{/i}靠近，不过，是的。

lines.en: : Well thank you for being so polite and informing me.
lines.zh: : 那还谢谢你这么客气地告诉我。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, Sensei, I thrive off of the piercing gazes of our classmates.
lines.zh: : 如果这算安慰的话，Sensei，我可是在同学们锐利的目光里茁壮成长的。

lines.en: : Come. Jump into my arms and show the world how we were meant to be.
lines.zh: : 来吧。跳进我的怀里，让全世界看看我们本该是什么样子。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be the one jumping into my arms?
lines.zh: : 不该是你跳进我怀里吗？

lines.en: : Too predictable. I say we shake things up a bit.
lines.zh: : 太老套了。我提议咱们换换花样。

lines.en: : Can I continue now or do you two want to keep being secret siblings for a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 我能继续了吗，还是说你们俩想再当一会儿秘密兄妹？

lines.en: scene rindemption4
: Apologies, Otoha. Please proceed with inviting Sensei to your topless slumber party.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Otoha。请继续邀请 Sensei 参加你的无上装睡衣派对吧。

lines.en: : I accept. I’ll mark it on my calendar.
lines.zh: : 我接受。我会记在日历上的。

lines.en: scene rindemption5
: At least wait until after[school] if you’re going to be a creep.
lines.zh: : 要发情也至少等到[school]放学之后吧。

lines.en: : Hey, {i}you’re{/i} the one who invited {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是{i}你{/i}邀请{i}我{/i}的吧。

lines.en: : There is no topless sleepover. I wanted to ask if we needed like, permission slips or whatever for the beach thing.
lines.zh: : 根本没有什么无上装睡衣派对。我想问的是，海滩那个活动我们需不需要什么家长同意书之类的。

lines.en: : Oh. No, you should be fine.
lines.zh: : 哦。不用，应该没问题的。

lines.en: scene rindemption6
: So...this[school] is just going to let a bunch of [teenage]girls stay overnight with a guy everyone is already suspicious of and not even make us get permission from our parents?
lines.zh: : 所以……这所[school]打算就这么让一群[teenage]女孩跟一个所有人都已经在怀疑的男人过夜，还不要求我们拿到父母的许可？

lines.en: : No one is suspicious of me. I’m a totally normal guy with totally normal taste in women.
lines.zh: : 没人怀疑我。我是个完全正常的男人，对女人的品味也完全正常。

lines.en: : Look. Just ask Makoto.
lines.zh: : 这样吧。去问 Makoto。

lines.en: scene rindemption7
: Hm? I’m Makoto.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我是 Makoto。

lines.en: : Why am I being mentioned?
lines.zh: : 为什么提到我？

lines.en: : Tell Otoha how normal I am.
lines.zh: : 告诉 Otoha 我有多正常。

lines.en: : You? Normal?
lines.zh: : 你？正常？

lines.en: : Next you’re going to be asking me to explain to her how Caligula was an entirely sane and widely appreciated emperor.
lines.zh: : 接下来你是不是还要我向她解释，卡利古拉是个完全神志正常、广受爱戴的皇帝？

lines.en: : That does not sound like something I would ever ask you to explain to anyone.
lines.zh: : 这听起来可不像是我会要你向任何人解释的东西。

lines.en: : Oh, Makoto. Loyal class representative and beautiful [young_girl].
lines.zh: : 哦，Makoto。忠诚的班长，美丽的[young_girl]。

lines.en: : Would you like to hold hands and lovingly peer through the frames of each other’s glasses for the rest of the day?
lines.zh: : 你愿意牵着我的手，在今天剩下的时间里含情脉脉地透过彼此的眼镜框互相对视吗？

lines.en: scene rindemption8
: Hello Nodoka. No thank you.
lines.zh: : 你好，Nodoka。不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Rats.
lines.zh: : 可恶。

lines.en: scene rindemption9
: If there’s something you’re curious about that Sensei doesn't know how to answer, you can always ask me.
lines.zh: : 如果有什么你好奇、而 Sensei 又答不上来的事，随时可以来问我。

lines.en: : I believe I overheard something about the beach?
lines.zh: : 我好像听到了「海滩」什么的？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I was just wondering if we needed to like, get permission from our parents or anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我就是想知道，我们要不要……拿到父母的许可什么的。

lines.en: scene rindemption10
: For any other class, yes. That is something you’d need.
lines.zh: : 换成别的班，是的。那是必须的。

lines.en: : However, given that I am not only the class president but the head of the student council and an occasional assistant to the principal, I have my ways of averting typical requirements like that.
lines.zh: : 不过，鉴于我不仅是班长，还是学生会主席、偶尔给校长打打下手，我有办法绕开这类常规要求。

lines.en: : So fear not, Otoha. I’m able to get all of you to the beach with just Sensei’s supervision alone.
lines.zh: : 所以别担心，Otoha。只要有 Sensei 一个人看着，我就能让你们全体去成海滩。

lines.en: : And that’s something you’re comfortable with?
lines.zh: : 而这你也能放心？

lines.en: scene rindemption11
: Wait. Yeah. Why am I just allowing this to happen?
lines.zh: : 等等。对啊。我凭什么就这么放任这事发生？

lines.en: : I’m supposed to be making sure the safety of the class is the top priority and-
lines.zh: : 我应该把全班的安全放在第一位才对，而且——

lines.en: : I, for one, feel there is no place safer than in the arms of a man twice my size.
lines.zh: : 就我而言，没有什么地方比一个体型是我两倍的男人的怀抱更安全了。

lines.en: : Come, Sensei. To the closet.
lines.zh: : 来吧，Sensei。去保洁柜。

lines.en: scene rindemption12
: The janitorial closets are off limits to staff members who aren’t part of the custodial roster.
lines.zh: : 保洁柜禁止非保洁人员编制内的教职员工使用。

lines.en: : Can’t there be a momentary exception to that on account of all of the lives that have been lost in that department?
lines.zh: : 就不能看在已经有多少条命折损在那间柜子里的份上，破个例？

lines.en: : Sure. As long as you sign out the needed materials.
lines.zh: : 可以。只要你把要用的东西登记领用就行。

lines.en: : Do they keep condoms in there?
lines.zh: : 里面有避孕套吗？

lines.en: scene rindemption13
: AS IF YOU’D WILLINGLY USE ONE OF THOSE!
lines.zh: : 你才不会心甘情愿用那玩意儿呢！

lines.en: : Oh? What’s this?
lines.zh: : 哦？这是什么情况？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: scene rindemption14
: I...just meant that...
lines.zh: : 我只是想说……

lines.en: : I heard somewhere that...boys think they’re uncomfortable and...
lines.zh: : 我听说……男生觉得戴了不舒服，而且……

lines.en: : Oh, I forgot. I have a...meeting to attend.
lines.zh: : 哦，我想起来了。我还有个……会要开。

lines.en: scene rindemption15
: Hah...
: At least I can get around having to tell my mom about this.
lines.zh: : 至少我省了跟我妈说这件事的麻烦。

lines.en: : Forget your mom. I want to hear more about what’s going on with Sensei and his faithful assistant.
lines.zh: : 别管你妈了。我想多听听 Sensei 和他那位忠实助手之间到底怎么回事。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Makoto was probably just a little upset about the whole janitorial topic since she used to be dating one of the custodians.
lines.zh: : Makoto 大概只是因为保洁这个话题有点激动，毕竟她以前跟一个保洁员交往过。

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} who was bumping into us during our first time?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}我们第一次的时候，一直撞我们的就是他？

lines.en: : Up until now, I had just assumed it was a mop.
lines.zh: : 直到现在我还以为那是把拖把。

lines.en: : Nope. That’s just how wet-
lines.zh: : 不是。那只是湿得——

lines.en: : Okaaaaythanksforyourtimebyeeee.
lines.zh: : 好——吧谢谢你的时间拜——拜。

lines.en: scene rindemption16
: Yumi, you don’t think we’d be able to bring Chinami to the beach if we like, be super careful about it, do you?
lines.zh: : Yumi，如果我们特别小心的话，你觉得能把 Chinami 带到海滩去吗？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. You’re the one who understands her health shit. I just know the outside world wants to kill her.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。懂她那堆健康破事的人是你。我只知道外面的世界想弄死她。

lines.en: : Beach seems pretty fuckin’ outside to me.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，海滩可是他妈的相当「外面」。

lines.en: : Chinami?
lines.zh: : Chinami？

lines.en: scene rindemption17
: Ah! I apologize!
lines.zh: : 啊！我很抱歉！

lines.en: : I inadvertently invited myself into a conversation I had no part in! How terribly rude of me!
lines.zh: : 我不小心插进了一场与我无关的对话！我真是太失礼了！

lines.en: : No no no! It’s totally fine. You can talk to us whenever you want!
lines.zh: : 不不不！完全没关系。你什么时候想跟我们说话都行！

lines.en: : No you can’t.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene rindemption18
: Chinami’s my little sister.
lines.zh: : Chinami 是我妹妹。

lines.en: : She’s a 5,000 year old wizard.
lines.zh: : 她是个五千岁的巫师。

lines.en: : What a strange coincidence. My little sister also happens to be a 5,000 year old wizard.
lines.zh: : 真是奇妙的巧合。我妹妹也刚好是个五千岁的巫师。

lines.en: : Wow! It’s so crazy that both of our sisters are 5,000 year old wizards!
lines.zh: : 哇！我们俩的妹妹都是五千岁的巫师，这也太巧了吧！

lines.en: : And um...I’m deeply sorry if it’s inappropriate for me, but... by health...{i}you know what,{/i} is your bodyguard referring to your sister's disorder?
lines.zh: : 而且嗯……如果这样问很失礼我深表歉意，不过……健康方面……{i}算了{/i}，你这位保镖说的是你妹妹的病吗？

lines.en: scene rindemption19
: Health “shit.” Stop actin’ like a fuckin’ princess and just say it.
lines.zh: : 健康的「破事」。别他妈装什么公主了，直说吧。

lines.en: : Bad words won’t fuckin’ kill you, you know.
lines.zh: : 脏话又他妈不会要你的命，你知道吧。

lines.en: : Yeah. She has to stay home most of the time and can’t really go anywhere without...protective gear.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她大部分时间都得待在家里，没有……防护装备的话基本哪儿也去不了。

lines.en: : You mean like...a hazmat suit of sorts?
lines.zh: : 你是说像……某种防化服之类的？

lines.en: : Guess again, but with more fur.
lines.zh: : 再猜一次，不过毛要多一些。

lines.en: : Chika?
lines.zh: : Chika？

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m just gonna go call her really quick and see how she’s doing.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我出去给她打个电话，看看她现在怎么样。

lines.en: scene rindemption20
: Wait! No! Now I’m alone with the bully!
lines.zh: : 等等！不要！现在我跟那个恶霸单独在一起了！

lines.en: : The fuck did you just call me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才叫我什么？

lines.en: scene rindemption21
: Mother?! Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 母亲？！Sensei？！

lines.en: : Anyone?!
lines.zh: : 来人啊？！

lines.en: scene rindemption22
: Heeeeeeeeeeeeeey.
: I need to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 我得跟你谈谈。

lines.en: : Okay, but make it quick. I think Touka is being murdered.
lines.zh: : 行，不过快点。我觉得 Touka 正在被谋杀。

lines.en: : Actually, is it okay if we talk out in the hall?
lines.zh: : 其实，我们能去走廊外面谈吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess if we have to. But if Touka dies, I’m blaming it on you.
lines.zh: : 行吧，如果非这样不可的话。不过要是 Touka 死了，我可怪你。

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei! Wait! There’s a girl! A strong one!
lines.zh: : Sensei！等等！有个女孩！很强壮的那种！

lines.en: : Makoto, watch the class while I’m-
lines.zh: : Makoto，帮我看着班，我去——

lines.en: : Oh, right. Makoto has a meeting.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。Makoto 有个会要开。

lines.en: : AAAAAHHHHH!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

lines.en: scene rindemption23
Rin pulls me out into the hallway and immediately slumps up against the window.
lines.zh: Rin 把我拉到走廊上，随即靠在窗边瘫了下来。

lines.en: I recall her doing something before the last beach trip when-
lines.zh: 我记得上一次海滩之行前她也做过类似的事，当时——

lines.en: : I’m gonna do it again.
lines.zh: : 我又要这么干一次了。

lines.en: : Do what again?
lines.zh: : 又要干什么？

lines.en: : You don’t mean-
lines.zh: : 你不会是说——

lines.en: : Ruin everything and then cry into your lap in my swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 把一切都搞砸，然后穿着泳衣趴在你腿上哭。

lines.en: : So...I just wanted to give you the heads up and stuff.
lines.zh: : 所以……我就是想先跟你说一声什么的。

lines.en: I’m not really sure what she expects me to say, but if she’s looking for encouragement or...positive reinforcement or something, she’d be better off with someone like Futaba.
lines.zh: 我不太确定她指望我说什么，不过如果她想要的是鼓励或者……正向肯定什么的，她找 Futaba 那样的人更合适。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
Especially since I still have no idea how I’m even supposed to interpret my relationship with her.
lines.zh: 尤其是我自己到现在都不知道该怎么定义跟她的关系。

lines.en: : I take it this means you won’t be confessing to me?
lines.zh: : 看来这意味着你不会跟我告白了？

lines.en: : Thought so.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: scene rindemption24
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : I want you to know that I don’t think kissing you was a mistake.
lines.zh: : 我想让你知道，我不觉得吻你是个错误。

lines.en: : You’re important to me and...even though I joke around about it sometimes, I really {i}do{/i} see you as more than a friend.
lines.zh: : 你对我很重要，而且……虽然我有时会拿这事开玩笑，但我{i}真的{/i}不只是把你当朋友。

lines.en: scene rindemption25
: But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Look at Otoha, man...
lines.zh: : 你看看 Otoha 啊，老兄……

lines.en: : Look at her...and then at me...and tell me that you think you’d be a better match.
lines.zh: : 看看她……再看看我……然后告诉我，你觉得你更配得上谁。

lines.en: : You can’t, right?
lines.zh: : 你说不出来，对吧？

lines.en: : Just liking each other isn’t enough reason for us to {i}be{/i} together.
lines.zh: : 光是互相喜欢，不足以成为我们{i}在一起{/i}的理由。

lines.en: : I want a girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 我想要个女朋友。

lines.en: : I want someone to trade clothes and chapstick with.
lines.zh: : 我想要一个能互相换衣服、换润唇膏用的人。

lines.en: : Someone who understands the way I feel a little better than some...much older guy.
lines.zh: : 一个比某个……年纪大很多的男人更能懂我感受的人。

lines.en: : Even if he's a really {i}cool{/i} older guy.
lines.zh: : 哪怕他是个特别{i}酷{/i}的大叔。

lines.en: : Well...I certainly {i}am{/i} very cool.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我{i}确实{/i}很酷。

lines.en: : Sensei...my feelings are already all stupid and immature.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我的感情本来就又蠢又不成熟。

lines.en: : Don't make it sound like I'm going to have to choose between both of you, because...
lines.zh: : 别弄得好像我非得在你们俩之间做选择似的，因为……

lines.en: : There's really only one way that choice would go right now.
lines.zh: : 现在这个选择会走向哪边，其实只有一个答案。

lines.en: scene rindemption26
: From the moment I first saw Otoha...I knew that I’d be doing this someday.
lines.zh: : 从我第一眼见到 Otoha 起……我就知道总有一天我会走到这一步。

lines.en: : Whether it be stalking her at the park or...doing it during some beach trip after a twist of fate lands her next to me in[school].
lines.zh: : 不管是在公园里跟踪她，还是……在命运的捉弄让她坐到我旁边之后，趁某次海滩之行动手。

lines.en: : It’s just...all so convenient.
lines.zh: : 只是……一切都太顺理成章了。

lines.en: : Like we’re supposed to be together or something.
lines.zh: : 就好像我们天生该在一起似的。

lines.en: : I just don’t want you getting ahead of yourself again. Or setting yourself up for disaster.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想你又操之过急。或者把自己推到灾难里。

lines.en: scene rindemption27
: Disaster is my middle name.
lines.zh: : 灾难就是我的中间名。

lines.en: : Or, at least it would be if middle names were commonplace in Japan.
lines.zh: : 或者说，如果日本有中间名这种东西的话，那就是了。

lines.en: : I’m destined to follow my heart and jump the gun over and over again. And it’s not like I want to, but I’m {i}going{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 我注定要跟着心走，一次又一次地操之过急。虽然我也不想，但我就是{i}会{/i}这么做。

lines.en: : That’s just what being impulsive means.
lines.zh: : 冲动就是这么回事。

lines.en: : So...if things really do blow up in my face again-
lines.zh: : 所以……如果事情真的又在我脸上炸开——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. My door will be-
lines.zh: : 别担心。我的门会——

lines.en: : Wait. Do I even have a room this time? Or am I just staying with the dorm war winners the whole time?
lines.zh: : 等等。这次我到底有没有房间？还是说我全程都跟宿舍大战的赢家住一起？

lines.en: scene rindemption28
: Oh.
: Huh.
: I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说……

lines.en: : We could always probably find a shed or something.
lines.zh: : 我们总能找到间小屋什么的吧。

lines.en: : How many sheds do you think are just...near the beach?
lines.zh: : 你觉得海滩附近能有……多少间小屋？

lines.en: : I don’t know, dude. There’s gotta be at least one, right?
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，老兄。总得有至少一间吧？

lines.en: scene rindemption29
Molly quietly and hesitantly slides open the door before joining the two of us in the hall.
lines.zh: Molly 犹豫着轻轻拉开门，走进走廊来到我们两个身边。

lines.en: My initial instinct is to leave the two of them alone to talk this out however normal [teenage]girls talk things out-
lines.zh: 我的第一反应是留下她们两个单独谈，随正常的[teenage]女孩怎么谈都好——

lines.en: But I was the one who was invited out here.
lines.zh: 但被叫出来的人是我。

lines.en: And I don’t even know if Rin wants to talk to Molly right now or not.
lines.zh: 而且我甚至不知道 Rin 现在想不想跟 Molly 说话。

lines.en: So I hang myself in the limbo of either being the second or third wheel (Or I suppose the indeterminate numbered wheel for the immediate future) and wait to see how things unfold.
lines.zh: 于是我把自己悬在一个尴尬的位置上——不知该当第二只还是第三只电灯泡（或者说，短期内当个编号不明的电灯泡），等着看事情怎么发展。

lines.en: : Molly?
lines.zh: : Molly？

lines.en: : Umm...
: Is your...mana...
lines.zh: : 你的……魔力……

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene rindemption30
: I’m fine. I just needed to talk to Sensei about something.
lines.zh: : 我没事。只是有些事要跟 Sensei 谈。

lines.en: : But thank you for checking up on me.
lines.zh: : 不过谢谢你来关心我。

lines.en: : You just...looked kind of nervous...
lines.zh: : 你只是……看起来有点紧张……

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} kind of nervous. But it’s not really something you need to get involved in.
lines.zh: : 我{i}是{/i}有点紧张。不过这事真不用你掺和。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : You know you...can involve me if-
lines.zh: : 你知道的……如果需要的话你可以让我参与——

lines.en: : Really, don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 真的，别担心。

lines.en: : I’m just being weird again. You know how I can be sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我只是又犯怪了。你知道我有时候就是这样的。

lines.en: scene rindemption31
: Yeah...
: I...worry about you a lot...
lines.zh: : 我……很担心你……

lines.en: : Like...
lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: : {i}A lot{/i} a lot...
lines.zh: : {i}非常{/i}非常担心……

lines.en: : Thank you. Really. But hopefully you won’t have to worry for much longer.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。真的。不过希望你不用再担心太久了。

lines.en: scene rindemption32
: Yeah...
: Hopefully...
lines.zh: : 希望吧……
